notes: This forum published no timetable at all until now; the page has since added image_20260804101731A685.png (1080x826), so its programme is transcribed here for the first time.
Timetable columns: 时间 / 报告题目 / 讲者 / 单位. Times are present for every row; no room/venue and no date are printed on the image.

The published table starts at 14:30, one hour into the 13:30-17:00 parallel-forum window, and runs to 17:30, half an hour past it. Both are as printed; nothing is cut off at the image edges (the header row is at the top and the table closes with a border under the last row).
The 15:50 title is printed '…实践 & LFAI&Data 开原生态' — '开原生态' where the rest of the site writes 开源生态. Kept as printed.
The 茶歇 row spans the three right-hand columns as one merged cell; no speaker is printed for it.
单位 prints organisations only, without job titles.
No room / hall / venue is shown anywhere in this document's images. The registration footer repeated on every forum page names the conference venue (重庆・山城国际会议中心), which is not a per-forum room.
